definitions.explanation: The sale of goods in large quantities, typically to retailers or other merchants rather than to end consumers.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{卸売|おろしうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This company does wholesale of vegetables.

examples.japanese: {卸売|おろしうり}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れる→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧。
{卸売|おろしうり}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I buy fish at the wholesale market.

notes:
{卸売|おろしうり} refers to the sale of goods in bulk to retailers or businesses, not directly to consumers. The opposite is ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧ (retail).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {卸売|おろしうり}⟦{業|ぎょう}→業：noentry⟧: wholesale business/trade
- {卸売|おろしうり}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: wholesale price
- {卸売|おろしうり}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: wholesale market
- {卸売|おろしうり}⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧: wholesaler

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧: retail (the opposite)
- ⟦{問屋|とんや}→問屋：07941_tonya⟧: wholesaler, wholesale dealer (traditional term)
- ⟦{仕入|しい}れ→仕入れ：07431_shiire⟧: purchasing, stocking (the buyer's side)
- ⟦{卸|おろし}→卸：noentry⟧: abbreviation, also used as a prefix

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{卸|おろ}す→卸す：02463_orosu⟧ (to wholesale/distribute) + ⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧ (selling).
